labeling_goal: Train query relevance so the product first separates pages that truly match the user query from strong-looking but off-topic pages.

pairing_policy.gold: Dedicated page for the exact product/service/topic and query intent.
pairing_policy.partial: Same broad vertical but weak landing match, wrong city, generic homepage or informational page for commercial intent.
pairing_policy.garbage: Unrelated vertical or page whose commercial/SEO quality is irrelevant to the user's query.
